svg.aria-label: Symmetric versus public-key cryptography: symmetric encryption uses one shared secret key and is fast, but the key must be shared securely; public-key cryptography uses a public key to encrypt or verify and a private key to decrypt or sign, which solves key distribution but is slow, so TLS uses it to agree on a symmetric session key.
svg.title: Symmetric versus public-key cryptography: symmetric encryption uses one shared secret key and is fast, but the key must be shared securely; public-key cryptography uses a public key to encrypt or verify and a private key to decrypt or sign, which solves key distribution but is slow, so TLS uses it to agree on a symmetric session key.
